title: Open-Source Browser Agent Test
script: Can an open-source browser agent turn six repositories into a usable CSV? Four fields each: stars, primary language, license, and latest repository update. I ran it on the same machine and recorded every intervention. Then I opened the CSV in a second app and checked all twenty-four fields. [CORRECT_FIELDS] fields were correct. [INTERVENTIONS] interventions. [EXPORT_RESULT]. [PRACTICAL_VERDICT]. Want another open-source agent test?
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: Six repositories; stars, language, license and last update into CSV.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: Can an open-source browser agent turn six repositories into a usable CSV?
Twenty-four fields. One browser agent. No guessing.
The CSV downloaded. Now we check what is inside.
strongestHook: Can an open-source browser agent turn six repositories into a usable CSV?
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Six repositories; stars, language, license and last update into CSV. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 15–60 minutes core build/test; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Use fixed repositories facebook/react, microsoft/vscode, vercel/next.js, vitejs/vite, sveltejs/svelte and remotion-dev/remotion. Ask an accessible open-source browser agent for stars, primary language, license and latest default-branch commit timestamp into CSV. Freeze tool/model/environment and 15-minute cap. Audit 24 fields plus parse/open the CSV independently. Log source URLs, collection timestamps, interventions, invalid output and recovery.
evidenceRequirements: Verify exact project/star count on recording day; audit all 24 extracted fields.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Browser Into CSV” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
instagramCaption: Open-Source Browser Agent Test. Six repositories; stars, language, license and last update into CSV. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. [PRACTICAL_VERDICT]. Want another open-source agent test?
tiktokCaption: Open-Source Browser Agent Test. WHAT TASK NEXT?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Complete run, repo pages, CSV, interventions.
